messages:
anya: Quick update for SDK owners: we're shipping a structured-output enforcement change for generation endpoints. Opt-in available now; default flip planned in 60 days. Please read and act.

chris: One-line summary?

anya: Servers will validate generated responses against user-provided schemas. If you opt into `enforce_schema=true` + `mode=reject`, mismatches will surface as API errors instead of silent best-effort fixes.

linh: Which SDKs are shipping support?

devex-bot: release-note: py-sdk@2.5.0, js-sdk@4.4.0, go-sdk@1.0.0 add `enforce_schema` and `schema_mode` flags.

marcus: Migration suggestion?

anya: Start in staging with `schema_mode=warn` (returns helpful warnings but 200). Run your prompts against canonical schemas. After a pass, try `schema_mode=reject` in a limited rollout.

chris: Docs actions?

docs-bot: Published draft: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/structured-output. Contains snippets, rollback patterns, and CI test examples.

linh: Performance/regression concerns?

anya: Small validation overhead (~5ms typical). New telemetry fields: schema_validation_ms and schema_issues. No billing changes.

marcus: Who to contact for escalations?

anya: Ping @anya, @linh or #devex. We'll run outreach for tenants showing many schema_issues.

chris: Thanks — I'll add quickstart snippet to our README and wire the CI test within 3 days.

anya: Great. Please comment on the staged guide if anything unexpected shows up.
